name: HoverCard
intent: Rich preview card revealed on hover — profile, entity, or link previews that are read, not interacted with.
when: Preview an entity/profile/link on hover without navigating
Show richer content than a Tooltip but without a click

chooseOver.because: Tooltip is short text; HoverCard holds formatted, richer preview content
Popover opens on click for interaction; HoverCard opens on hover for preview

commonMistakes.mistake: Put primary actions in a HoverCard
commonMistakes.fix: It is preview-only; use Popover or DropdownMenu
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Put primary actions in a HoverCard — it is preview-only; use Popover or DropdownMenu

usage: Use HoverCard to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing throughout your application.
HoverCard works well for arranging related content, creating responsive layouts, and maintaining visual consistency. Use it to group related elements and establish clear content boundaries.

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistent structure
bestPractices.description: Use the same card layout pattern throughout your application.

bestPractices.title: Don't mix card styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using different card structures for similar content types.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate elevation
bestPractices.description: Apply shadow/elevation that reflects the card's importance and context.

bestPractices.title: Don't over-elevate
bestPractices.description: Avoid heavy shadows on every card, reserve for interactive or important items.

bestPractices.title: Keep content scannable
bestPractices.description: Structure card content for quick scanning with clear hierarchy.

bestPractices.title: Don't cram too much
bestPractices.description: Avoid overloading cards with excessive content or actions.
